subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks gain a permanent public resetSession API, and should that contract include the explicit-session-key compatibility overload?
rationale: The branch adds a new plugin capability affecting persisted session state, while the compatibility form comes from an unmerged prior proposal and an external deployed consumer rather than a shipped OpenClaw contract.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only in eligible after-compaction contexts, document its deferred result, and remove the explicit-key overload.

options.title: Approve temporary compatibility
options.body: Keep the explicit-key overload only with a named deprecation window, upgrade documentation, and tests proving it cannot target another session.

options.title: Decline the core hook API
options.body: Keep session rotation behind an owner-specific compaction or plugin seam instead of expanding PluginHookAgentContext.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only in eligible after-compaction contexts, document its deferred result, and remove the explicit-key overload.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Codex and session-continuity work is the strongest available history signal for the affected lifecycle and API boundary.
